title: Mail sent to me as cc: and/or bcc:  (but not as To:) is received at ISP mail server, but Thunderbird will not retrieve.
creator: dave488
content:
Mail sent to me as cc: and/or bcc: addressee (but not as a To: addressee) is received at my ISP mail account, but Thunderbird will not retrieve them.

This has been going for a long while it seems, but I don't get much mail addressed as cc: or bcc:, so I only recently became aware of it.

My ISP webmail interface uses Roundcube. Cc: and bcc: messages sent to me show up there. I have Thunderbird 156.0 installed on two macOS 27.0 machines and Thunderbird 24.0b2 installed on Android 17 (includes all updates through Android security update of September 5, 2026). Neither of the three will retrieve the cc: or bcc: messages, but all other e-mail functions work as expected.

My ISP says it's a Thunderbird problem, but I ain't so sure. Any ideas?
